newsitem.title: UK: Thurs wet Brent late passed after dispute - trade.
newsitem.headline: Thurs wet Brent late passed after dispute - trade.

text.p: The single wet Brent due to turn wet on Thursday was late passed to Stasco by Cargill, a trader said on Friday.
The pass was made after a dispute between Cargill and Esso over the status of the July 11-13 loader.
Brent cargoes are traded on a paper, or forward market until the 1700 London time deadline on the nearest trading day 15 days before their assigned loading date.
A trading company is clocked when it is left with a paper cargo which has turned physical after that deadline and therefore cannot be passed on as part of pre-sold paper cargo deals.
